publication_status: Published profile — taxonomy notes independently maintained
host_note: Some Jiangxi reports use Chinese vernacular plant names without verified species-level botanical identification; these are not assigned Latin binomials.
taxonomy_summary: Diapus truncatus Niijima & Murayama, 1934. Original description and historical taxonomic treatments are displayed with claim-specific source verification; provisional distribution and host assertions remain separate from nomenclatural decisions.

taxonomic_history.name: Diapus spatulifer
taxonomic_history.note: Beaver (2000) treated this name as a subjective junior synonym of D. truncatus, following direct type comparisons.

nomenclature_note: Diapus spatulifer Browne, 1977 was treated as a subjective junior synonym in Beaver (2000); the source-specific synonymy was directly reviewed. Chinese host submissions remain separate from this taxonomic decision.

resources.images: No image with confirmed public reuse rights is linked in this release.
resources.specimens: Specimen/type evidence is recorded in the cited original descriptions; specimen accessions have not been independently mapped to online repositories.

provenance.scope: Distribution and host entries are consolidated and accepted for website presentation; specific unresolved nomenclatural and biological qualifications remain separately annotated.
